افترضتا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَرَضَتَا (iftaraḍatā) /if.ta.ra.dˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# اُفْتُرِضَتَا (ufturiḍatā) /uf.tu.ri.dˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
